name: Jeannette Bohg
title: Associate Professor of Computer Science
lab_name: Interactive Perception and Robot Learning Lab (IPRL)
research_topics: imitation learning from in-the-wild human video
dexterous / contact-rich manipulation with force sensing
current_direction: Diagnosing and repairing vision-language-action (VLA) policy failures, especially steerability loss under low-data post-training
Training manipulation policies from in-the-wild human video instead of robot teleoperation data
Data-centric robot learning: curating, editing and pretraining on the right data rather than scaling blindly
Whole-body and bimanual mobile manipulation via hybrid imitation plus whole-body control
Zero-shot dexterous and contact-rich tool manipulation through object-centric sim-to-real policies
current_direction_basis: Driven by the 2026 preprints and accepted papers listed on the IPRL publications page and cross-confirmed in OpenAlex: 'Demystifying When and Why VLAs Fail in Contact-Rich Tasks and How to Fix Them' (arXiv Aug 2026), 'Breaking Lock-In: Preserving Steerability under Low-Data VLA Post-Training' (arXiv Apr 2026) and 'CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy' (arXiv Jun 2026) drive the VLA line; 'Masquerade: Learning from In-the-wild Human Videos using Data-Editing' (ICRA 2026) and 'Phantom: Training Robots Without Robots Using Only Human Videos' (CoRL 2025) drive the human-video line; 'CUPID: Curating Data your Robot Loves with Influence Functions' (CoRL 2025), 'Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining' (arXiv Jul 2026) and 'Robot-Powered Data Flywheels' (arXiv Nov 2025) drive the data-centric line; 'HoMeR' (ICRA 2026), 'HoMMI' (RSS 2026) and 'Mixture of Frames Policy' (arXiv Jul 2026) drive the mobile-manipulation line; 'SimToolReal' (RSS 2026) and 'Gentle Object Retraction in Dense Clutter Using Multimodal Force Sensing' (RA-L 2025) drive the dexterous/contact-rich line. Deliberately NOT based on her biography, which on both her personal site and the Stanford Profiles bio still describes older multi-modal scene-understanding-for-grasping work.

evidence.title: Demystifying When and Why VLAs Fail in Contact-Rich Tasks and How to Fix Them
evidence.summary: Preprint (arXiv, August 2026) by Carlota Pares-Morlans, Nils Kuhn, Isabel Liu, Alberta Longhini, Jeannette Bohg. Most recent item listed under Preprints on the IPRL publications page; analyzes failure modes of vision-language-action policies on contact-rich manipulation.

evidence.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
evidence.summary: Preprint by Tyler Ga Wei Lum*, Kushal Kedia*, C. Karen Liu†, Jeannette Bohg† on dexterous play-based pretraining for precise assembly. Listed as 'arXiv, July 2026' on the IPRL publications page; OpenAlex records publication_date 2026-06-24.

evidence.title: CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy
evidence.summary: Preprint by Ria Doshi, Tian Gao, Annie Chen, Chelsea Finn, Jeannette Bohg on running decentralized multi-embodiment collaboration from a single vision-language-action policy. Cross-confirmed on the IPRL publications page (arXiv, June 2026) and OpenAlex (2026-06-10).

evidence.title: SimToolReal: An Object-Centric Policy for Zero-Shot Dexterous Tool Manipulation
evidence.summary: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026; authors Kushal Kedia*, Tyler Ga Wei Lum*, Jeannette Bohg†, C. Karen Liu†. Listed under the 2026 section of the IPRL publications page and announced in the lab's April 2026 news item; OpenAlex records the preprint at 2026-02-18.
